# Free Range Websites

> Free Range Websites is an Australian family-run business that builds websites for tradies and local small businesses. We design and build the website for free, with nothing to pay until the client has seen the finished site and approved it. After that it's $199 per month for the Free Range Care Plan, which covers hosting, security, backups and unlimited content updates. There is no lock-in contract, no setup fee and no exit fee — clients can cancel any time with 30 days notice. Clients can buy the code outright for a flat $1,800 at any point from day one, with no minimum tenure. Based in Melbourne, working with businesses across Australia.

## How the offer works

- Website build: free. No setup fee, nothing upfront.
- Ongoing: $199/month (AUD) for the Free Range Care Plan — hosting, SSL, security, backups, unlimited content updates, domain management.
- Draft delivered within 5 business days of the completed intake form, or the client's first month is free.
- Clients pay nothing until they have reviewed and approved the finished site.
- No lock-in contract. Cancel any time with 30 days notice. No exit fee.
- Code buyout: flat $1,800 for a standard build, available from day one. Made to Order builds are quoted individually.
- Clients always own their own domain and their own content.
- Includes a 5-page website, copywriting, on-site SEO, Google Business Profile setup, Google Analytics and Search Console, contact form, click-to-call.

## What we do not do

- We do not offer off-site SEO, link building or ongoing ranking campaigns.
- We do not promise first-page Google rankings or guarantee leads. Nobody can promise that.
- We do not use fake reviews, fictional testimonials, or artificial countdown timers.
